summary: Turkish diacritic preservation and toast settlement lifecycle verified: switching to Turkish locale sets document lang='tr' and renders exact typographical characters across navigation labels (Genel Bakış, Görünürlük, Promptlar, İş Akışları, Fırsatlar, Sayfalar) with zero unicode replacement characters (�). Toast notification mounts #toast.show with Turkish diacritics ('AEO İçgörü Testi Başarılı') and auto-settles cleanly after duration, resetting window.isToastShowing.
